name: browser
headline: Lightpanda: Headless Browser for AI Automation
short_description: Lightpanda is a powerful headless browser tailored for AI and automation tasks, enabling browser automation with tools like Playwright and Puppeteer. Ideal for developers looking to streamline workflows and enhance productivity.
author: lightpanda-io

sections.overview:
Lightpanda is a headless browser purpose-built for AI agents and automation workflows. It supports browser automation through standard protocols and tools, making it compatible with popular frameworks like Playwright and Puppeteer. The browser is designed to streamline web automation tasks, enabling AI agents to interact with web pages, extract data, and perform automated workflows. Lightpanda addresses the need for a browser engine optimized specifically for AI-driven automation rather than traditional user-facing browsing. It helps developers and AI systems efficiently automate web interactions and testing scenarios.
Automating web scraping tasks to extract data from multiple sources quickly.
Testing web applications without a GUI to ensure functionality and performance.
Integrating browser automation into CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployment processes.
Creating bots for data collection to gather insights from various web platforms.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install lightpanda-io/browser`
`git clone https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser`
sections.usage:
```
Use Lightpanda to automate a browser task for [WEBSITE]. Specifically, I need to [TASK] on [PAGE_URL]. Ensure the automation handles [SPECIFIC_CONDITIONS] and outputs the results in [DESIRED_FORMAT].
```
Copy

```
Task: Scrape product prices from an e-commerce site.

Lightpanda successfully automated the process of navigating to the specified e-commerce site and extracting product prices. The automation handled dynamic content loading and pagination, ensuring all product prices were captured. The results were outputted in a structured JSON format, making it easy to analyze and integrate into the existing pricing database. The automation completed the task in under 5 minutes, saving hours of manual work.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
